Label: Temporary end date for LOT1 base period
Definition (Validated from Protocol): The LOT will continue until the earliest of any of the following events: (1) substitution of a biologic reference product with any of its biosimilars does not advance the LOT; (2) discontinuation of all agents in the regimen - the LOT end date is based on the run-out date, defined as the last date that any MM medication in that LOT is considered to be available; (3) unplanned SCTs - if an autologous SCT occurs >180 days following a previous autologous SCT, the LOT will end the day before the latter SCT; any allogeneic SCTs are considered a new LOT; (4) SCTs not followed by maintenance within 180 days - the last day of the LOT is the date of the SCT; (5) death; (6) health plan disenrollment; (7) end of the study period; (8) end of maintenance regimen.
